content: When prescribing medications, it is important to avoid or substitute alternative drugs whenever possible to minimize potential interactions. If coadministration of certain drugs is unavoidable, evaluate for any loss of therapeutic effect and adjust the dosage as per the prescribing information. Key Drug Interactions with Elbasvir/Grazoprevir: 1. Armodafinil: This drug decreases the levels or effects of elbasvir/grazoprevir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. 2. Atazanavir: This drug increases the levels of elbasvir/grazoprevir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. It is contraindicated due to the risk of toxicity. 3. Atorvastatin: Elbasvir/grazoprevir increases atorvastatin levels. If coadministered, do not exceed an atorvastatin dose of 20 mg/day. Monitor closely for adverse effects. 4. Belzutifan: This drug decreases the levels of elbasvir/grazoprevir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism.
